systems: GitHub Actions: a step changes the next step's PATH only through $GITHUB_PATH; an export or a write into an off-PATH directory is lost at the step boundary
dtolnay/rust-toolchain and actions/setup-*: every installer action that writes binaries outside the runner PATH appends that directory to $GITHUB_PATH in the same step
rustup-init: installs into CARGO_HOME/bin and then edits the shell profile, because an install the next shell cannot resolve is not an install
crux.verdict: No crux row is owed: putting the install directory on the next step's PATH in the installing step is the practice all three follow; this branch adopts it for the nightly leg and tests it by replaying the runner's PATH.
